description.short: Investigate workplace IT problems with recent ServiceNow incidents
description.full: Investigate reported workplace IT symptoms, including failed access, unavailable or slow applications, service outages, and remote connectivity trouble, even without a ticket number or ServiceNow terminology. Read recent incidents and change requests from your configured ServiceNow instance, cite source links, and include requested Microsoft 365 background. Respect explicit source restrictions; ordinary document-finding without an IT problem does not call for incident lookup. The connection is read-only and cannot create, update, assign, approve, or resolve records.

agentConnectors.description: Find recent ServiceNow incidents behind reported workplace IT symptoms, even without a ticket number; read-only.
